James recounts an event earlier that morning where independent journalist Patrick Hawley disrupted a "Coffee & Conversation" forum with Darlene Graham before being escorted out. He further analyzes Citadel voter polling data showing strong Democratic support among newer residents and criticizes mainstream political trends. Concluding the hour, James warns listeners about potential organized unrest following upcoming elections, detailing what he characterizes as media and activist preparation for a "color revolution" intended to challenge election legitimacy.
